title: 鐵路路基過渡段處理
summary: 鐵路路基過渡段處理以「剛度漸變排水與差異沉陷的協同」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。路基過渡段把柔性土工支承連到較硬的橋台或涵洞，幾何高差與剛度突變會互相放大，單次起道不能消除深層沉陷。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops stiffness grading drainage and differential settlement through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. A transition connects flexible earth support to a stiffer abutment or culvert; level differences and stiffness jumps can amplify one another, and a single lifting correction cannot remove deep settlement. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm; y=P/k1-P/k2=1 mm. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.1 mm. Boundary: Two independent linear supports; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: khard=80 kN/mm, ksoft=20 kN/mm; y=khard/ksoft=4 1. Increasing only khard with a ten-percent increase gives y=4.4 1. Boundary: Equivalent stiffness over the same load interval; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

stages.title: 相鄰支承位移差與剛度比值辨認
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「相鄰支承位移差」與「剛度比值辨認」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Adjacent-support displacement difference" and "Stiffness-ratio identification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 相鄰支承位移差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Adjacent-support displacement difference: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「相鄰支承位移差」如何影響鐵路路基過渡段處理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Adjacent-support displacement difference” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway subgrade transition treatment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同載重下不同支承剛度造成位移差。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.1 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩個獨立線性支承。使用兩側同步載重位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；局部懸空使差異增加，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「相鄰支承位移差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different support stiffnesses create displacement differences under equal load. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.1 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Two independent linear supports. Use simultaneous load-displacement on both sides as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Local loss of support enlarges the mismatch; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Adjacent-support displacement difference” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm；y=P/k1-P/k2=1 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=60 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm; y=P/k1-P/k2=1 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部懸空使差異增加」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=60 kN, k1=30 kN/mm, k2=60 kN/mm；y=P/k1-P/k2=1 mm。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=1.1 mm。模型邊界：兩個獨立線性支承；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.1 mm. Boundary: Two independent linear supports; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Adjacent-support displacement difference” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以兩側同步載重位移區分模型與觀察，先用荷重元及雙位移計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「相鄰支承位移差」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use simultaneous load-displacement on both sides to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Adjacent-support displacement difference. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. stages.description: 本階段聚焦「填土壓縮量級」與「排水流量估算」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fill compression scale" and "Drainage discharge estimate": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 填土壓縮量級：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fill compression scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「填土壓縮量級」如何影響鐵路路基過渡段處理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fill compression scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway subgrade transition treatment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壓縮模數把應力增量連到層厚變化。本模型把 stress 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 13.2 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。一維均勻壓縮。使用應力與分層位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；非線性與排水歷程會改變等效模數，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「填土壓縮量級」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Constrained modulus links stress increase to thickness change. In this model, stress is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 13.2 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform one-dimensional compression. Use stress and layer movements as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Nonlinearity and drainage history change equivalent modulus; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fill compression scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：stress=80 kPa, H=3 m, M=20000 kPa；y=stress*H/M*1000=12 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: stress=80 kPa, H=3 m, M=20000 kPa; y=stress*H/M*1000=12 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：非線性與排水歷程會改變等效模數」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Nonlinearity and drainage history change equivalent modulus." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「填土壓縮量級」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fill compression scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 填土壓縮量級：定量估算
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「填土壓縮量級」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fill compression scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：stress=80 kPa, H=3 m, M=20000 kPa；y=stress*H/M*1000=12 mm。只把 stress 增加百分之十，y=13.2 mm。模型邊界：一維均勻壓縮；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: stress=80 kPa, H=3 m, M=20000 kPa; y=stress*H/M*1000=12 mm. Increasing only stress with a ten-percent increase gives y=13.2 mm. Boundary: Uniform one-dimensional compression; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以應力與分層位移區分模型與觀察，先用層間沉陷計與載荷帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use stress and layer movements to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 填土壓縮量級：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fill compression scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「填土壓縮量級」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fill compression scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以應力與分層位移區分模型與觀察，先用層間沉陷計與載荷帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「填土壓縮量級」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use stress and layer movements to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using layer settlement gauges and load ledger, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Fill compression scale. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「填土壓縮量級」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出一維均勻壓縮如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由非線性與排水歷程會改變等效模數造成偏離的合成觀察，以應力與分層位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Fill compression scale, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniform one-dimensional compression. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Nonlinearity and drainage history change equivalent modulus. Explain which evidence in stress and layer movements distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：非線性與排水歷程會改變等效模數。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Nonlinearity and drainage history change equivalent modulus. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 填土壓縮量級：失效診斷
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「填土壓縮量級」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fill compression scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 非線性與排水歷程會改變等效模數。這個失效與「填土壓縮量級」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查應力與分層位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Nonlinearity and drainage history change equivalent modulus. This failure and a measurement bias in Fill compression scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check stress and layer movements rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用應力與分層位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；非線性與排水歷程會改變等效模數，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：非線性與排水歷程會改變等效模數」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Nonlinearity and drainage history change equivalent modulus." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 調整剩餘空間：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「調整剩餘空間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Remaining adjustment range” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以已用與預留調整量區分模型與觀察，先用竣工調整紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「調整剩餘空間」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use used and reserved adjustment to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using as-built adjustment records, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Remaining adjustment range. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「調整剩餘空間」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出同方向代數餘量如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由重複整正可能耗盡調整範圍造成偏離的合成觀察，以已用與預留調整量說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Remaining adjustment range, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Algebraic reserve in one direction. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Repeated correction can exhaust adjustment range. Explain which evidence in used and reserved adjustment distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重複整正可能耗盡調整範圍。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated correction can exhaust adjustment range. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 調整剩餘空間：失效診斷
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「調整剩餘空間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Remaining adjustment range” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 重複整正可能耗盡調整範圍。這個失效與「調整剩餘空間」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查已用與預留調整量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated correction can exhaust adjustment range. This failure and a measurement bias in Remaining adjustment range can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check used and reserved adjustment rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用已用與預留調整量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；重複整正可能耗盡調整範圍，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Repeated correction can exhaust adjustment range; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：重複整正可能耗盡調整範圍」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Repeated correction can exhaust adjustment range." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
